description: This file defines an internal interface IMemberDescription and a sealed class MemberDescriptionTypeComparer within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. The interface specifies properties and methods related to member descriptions, such as symbol information and type details. The class provides equality comparison logic for IMemberDescription instances based on type and assembly names.

classes.name: IMemberDescription
classes.description: An internal interface representing a member description with properties for field ID, symbol, type, and other metadata.

classes.name: MemberDescriptionTypeComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IEqualityComparer<IMemberDescription> for comparing member descriptions based on their type and assembly names.

methods.name: GetTypeSyntax
methods.description: Generates a TypeSyntax object from a given ITypeSymbol.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines equality between two IMemberDescription objects based on TypeName and AssemblyName.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for an IMemberDescription object based on TypeName and AssemblyName.
